A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jinda/Legends|Jinda]] [[Jinda Dancers|dancer]] served as the '''assistant''' to [[Trebla]] the [[Magic/Legends|magician]] during the [[Travelling Jindas]]' performance to the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. He used his "powers" to [[Telekinesis/Legends|levitate]] her, but in actual fact she was lifted from the ground via [[Rope/Legends|ropes]] and harness.
